description: Transition PEP 440 build numbers from daily date resets to monotonic cumulative counters (+build.r# and rc#).
payload: * **Operational Tool & Library Versioning (PEP 440):** All production tools under `tools/ops/`, `tools/sys/`, and shared framework libraries under `tools/lib/` must declare module-level `__version__` strings adhering to PEP 440 local build identifiers using monotonic cumulative counters (`<major>.<minor>.<rev>+build.r<counter>`). Pre-release development candidates use PEP 440 candidate tags preceding the build segment (`<major>.<minor>.<rev>rc<candidate>+build.r<counter>`). Daily calendar resets of build counters are prohibited.
